question_text: Explain how you would design a URL shortener service. Discuss your approach in words; no code is needed.
llm_system_explanation: Steps the candidate must cover: (1) generating a short unique key, for example a counter encoded in base62 or a hash with collision handling; (2) storing the key to URL mapping in a database; (3) redirecting a short link by looking up the key; (4) handling read-heavy traffic with a cache. Hint after failed attempt 1: ask how they would make sure two long URLs never get the same short key. Hint after failed attempt 2: ask what happens to the database when one popular link is opened millions of times.
